description: Demo tenant (demo_hospital) curated catalog — used by the C1 multi-tenant test suite to confirm that per-tenant catalogs load correctly. This file is safe to delete in production; it's checked in so CI can exercise the tenant-lookup code path. Intentionally minimal: only one condition, so the test can assert a difference from the default catalog.
_notes: This catalog ONLY overrides Panik Bozukluk with a demo description.
All other curated labels (Majör Depresyon, Akut Otitis Media, …) are absent here, which is itself the test — a partial override must not crash the orchestrator.
In production a hospital would author this file through the admin UI (C2, upcoming).
disclaimer_tr: DEMO — Bu katalog yalnızca multi-tenant test içindir; klinik kullanım için değildir.

Panik Bozukluk.disease_description_tr: [DEMO TENANT] Panik bozukluk demo açıklaması — bu metin demo_hospital kataloğundan yüklendiği zaman görünür. Default tenant'tan farklı olmalıdır.
